Typical forwarding: file-beat relay from application server log directories; DB export for audit tables. Source-shape acquisition is blocked; no relay envelope selected and no validated parser exists yet. Operator action required: provide fixture events before this source can be promoted.

pack_variants.label: PeopleSoft signon/authentication audit
pack_variants.description: PeopleSoft signon/authentication audit: PeopleSoft signon table/export/log.
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: signon audit is DATABASE TABLE data (PSPTLOGINAUDIT columns PT_AUTH_TYPE/OPRID/PT_SIGNON_STATUS/FAILEDLOGINS/LASTSIGNONDTTM; PSACCESSLOG signon/signout by OPRID), not an emitted log line. Collection is DB query export, not syslog.

PSPTLOGINAUDIT is volatile: a successful login clears the user's failure rows, so streaming-from-table loses failed-login history. Catalogue-only; a chosen collector's export schema (JSON/CSV) and read-back are required before promotion.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

pack_variants.label: PeopleSoft security audit
pack_variants.description: PeopleSoft security audit: PeopleTools security/user/role audit.
source_modes: PSAUDIT / record-level / DB-level trigger audit tables (DB export)
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: record/field/DB-level audit is DATABASE TABLE / trigger data (PSAUDIT field audit, custom record-audit tables, trigger-based DB-level audit with AUDIT_* columns and AUDIT_STAMP), not an emitted log line. DB-level (trigger) audit captures changes made outside the PeopleSoft UI, including security-table changes.
Catalogue-only: DB export only; a chosen collector's export schema and read-back are required before promotion.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

pack_variants.label: PeopleSoft application server logs
pack_variants.description: PeopleSoft application server logs: app server logs.
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: documented single-line grammar `ServerProcess.PID (ServiceReqNum) [ISO8601.ms] SRID TOP OperatorID (LogLevel) Message`; timestamp has no UTC offset by default; correlation fields are positional but often `-`; field separator is configurable (LogFieldSeparator).

Promotable-with-sample: strongest PeopleSoft candidate, but a real sanitised sample is required to lock the separator variant and placeholder behaviour before a parser. File-tail only; no native syslog emitter.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

pack_variants.label: PeopleSoft process scheduler
pack_variants.description: PeopleSoft process scheduler: process scheduler logs/exports.
source_modes: SCHDLR.LOG process scheduler server log (file tail)
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: SCHDLR.LOG shares the server-process logging framework (LOGFENCE 0-5, single-line); the full positional grammar is not re-printed, so confirm identical layout with a fixture.

Authoritative process/report failure status lives in DB tables (PSPRCSRQST etc.), not SCHDLR.LOG; the log is operational/diagnostic. Promotable-with-sample alongside the app-server slice; file-tail only.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

pack_variants.label: PeopleSoft Integration Broker
pack_variants.description: PeopleSoft Integration Broker: IB logs/monitoring exports.
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: IB dispatcher/handler processes (PSBRKDSP, PSPUBDSP, PSSUBDSP...) log to the standard server-process single-line format and fold into the app-server grammar.

IB gateway logs are .html files (msgLog.html/errorLog.html), created only when logging occurs, with configurable path/level; the per-entry field grammar is not publicly documented and HTML is not line-oriented, so the gateway sub-source stays blocked pending a captured sample.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

2026-07-03 PeopleSoft Oracle-official evidence pass (docs/research/oracle-official-peoplesoft-log-source-shape-evidence-20260703.md): the server-process log family (APPSRV.LOG, SCHDLR.LOG, Tuxedo ULOG, IB dispatcher logs) is file-tailable with a documented single-line grammar and is promotable-with-sample; signon/security audit (PSPTLOGINAUDIT/PSACCESSLOG/PSAUDIT) are DATABASE TABLES collected by DB export, not logs; IB gateway HTML logs stay blocked. PeopleSoft has no native syslog emitter.

PeopleSoft stays inside this pack (no standalone pack); PIA web-tier logs are covered by packs/oracle_weblogic and packs/oracle_ohs. JDE and Siebel follow the same file-tail-ops-log vs DB-table-audit pattern and remain catalogue-only.
Routing stays disabled because no sanitised sample or live SC4S TEST -> HEC -> Splunk TEST read-back was captured; documented shape evidence alone does not promote trust.
Trust remains unverified and quality remains catalogued; do not promote from CI or pack presence.
Oracle logs/exports may contain sensitive users, SQL text/binds, business data, OCIDs, hostnames, request parameters, or tenant identifiers; sample capture requires sanitisation.
